statements.markdown: **Proposition 6.98 (Error in the finite subseries value).** *An exact row at endpoint $n$ has real value within $O(n/2^n)$ of $1/2$: the quantitative bound $|y_n-1/2|\le(n+1)/2^n$ consumed by Theorem [6.67](#record:257bm-c1) to turn a sequence of exact rows tending to depth infinity into a sequence of values tending to $1/2$.*
